id: 28
slug: shapes
title: Shapes
difficulty: easy
signature: int shapes(TreeNode a, TreeNode b, TreeNode c, TreeNode d, NaryNode e, ListNode l, int depth)
---
A fixture for the list and tree helpers of lc_gen.h: gen.c prints a
complete tree, a zigzag path, a binary search tree made by insertion, a
random shape made a search tree by its in-order, an N-ary tree from
parents, a list, and the depth of the search tree, which is the answer.
